Enum Class FileStoreOrganization

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FileStoreOrganization>
org.applecommander.filestore.FileStoreOrganization
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<FileStoreOrganization>, Constable
public enum FileStoreOrganization extends Enum<FileStoreOrganization>
Indicator for the organization of the file store. If the file store is an archive, just use the archive organization. Otherwise, pick the most appropriate image type.

    • createSource

      public Source createSource(String fileExtension)
      Create the source object for this FileStore organization. The extension is required due to the fact that all archives are under ARCHIVE. Expected to be used directly by all archive and indirectly by all disk images.
